subject.title: Bug: 升级后 Dashboard 历史会话索引/映射错乱

question: What recovery policy should OpenClaw use when a Dashboard session key maps to the wrong stored `sessionId` but preserved transcript or trajectory files still exist?
rationale: The code can prove the malformed state misroutes history, but choosing a repair rule requires maintainer intent because the wrong rule can expose or attach private conversation history to the wrong visible session.

options.title: Identity-backed doctor recovery
options.body: Add a doctor/diagnostic repair that uses durable identity or strong trajectory evidence, previews candidate relinks, and refuses ambiguous cases.

options.title: Wait for transcript identity
options.body: Keep #86304 open until #84209 or equivalent header identity lands, then repair old mappings only when that metadata proves ownership.

options.title: Fold into storage flip
options.body: Require the SQLite storage flip line to include explicit corrupted Dashboard mapping import proof before treating this issue as fixed.

recommendation.title: Identity-backed doctor recovery
recommendation.body: Add a doctor/diagnostic repair that uses durable identity or strong trajectory evidence, previews candidate relinks, and refuses ambiguous cases.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent transcript reader identity work and current storage flip follow-up make this the closest owner for deciding the durable recovery boundary.
